comment: Route pack areas: NOAA Chart Display Service (NCDS) regions, built from every active ENC cell that covers them (ncds_bbox = NOAA's region rectangle), (legacy areas built from state sets, with states + bbox, still work). Each area's 'tests' run on its own pack; top-level 'tests' run on the packs listed in their 'areas'. 'nm' is the accepted length range, 'fail' marks routes that must be refused, 'avoid' lists [lat, lon, meters] the route must keep away from. Nothing is published unless every test passes.

areas.name: Region 02a: Long Island Sound and the Hudson
areas.description: Long Island Sound north of 41.1 N and its east end, the Hudson River from Haverstraw to Troy, the Connecticut and Rhode Island coasts, Block Island Sound and Narragansett Bay.

areas.name: Region 03: New York Harbor and New Jersey
areas.description: New York Harbor and the Hudson to the Tappan Zee, western Long Island Sound, Long Island's south shore, the NJ coast north of Barnegat, and the Delaware River from Wilmington to Trenton.

areas.name: Region 04: Upper Chesapeake and Delaware Bay
areas.description: Upper and mid Chesapeake (Susquehanna Flats to Solomons), the Potomac to Washington, the C&D Canal, Delaware Bay and River to Wilmington, the NJ coast from Cape May to Barnegat.

areas.name: Region 05: Lower Chesapeake and Hampton Roads
areas.description: Lower Chesapeake, the lower Potomac, Hampton Roads and Norfolk, the Delmarva and Virginia Atlantic coast, Albemarle Sound.

areas.name: Region 06: North Carolina and northern South Carolina
areas.description: Pamlico Sound and Hatteras, the Neuse and Pamlico Rivers, Beaufort and Morehead City, Wilmington and Cape Fear, Myrtle Beach, Charleston, and the Savannah River to Augusta.

areas.name: Region 07: Southern South Carolina, Georgia and northeast Florida
areas.description: Beaufort and Hilton Head, Savannah, the Georgia sea islands, Fernandina, Jacksonville and the St. Johns River, and the Florida coast to Cape Canaveral.

areas.name: Region 02b: Massachusetts and Cape Cod
areas.description: Buzzards Bay, the Elizabeth Islands, Martha's Vineyard and Nantucket, the Cape Cod Canal, Cape Cod Bay, Boston Harbor and Massachusetts Bay north to about Cape Ann.

areas.name: Region 08: Southeast Florida
areas.description: The Indian River Lagoon south of Cape Canaveral, the Atlantic coast and ICW from Sebastian to Miami, Biscayne Bay, and the upper Keys to Key Largo.

areas.name: Region 10: Southwest Florida and the Keys
areas.description: Tampa Bay, Sarasota, Charlotte Harbor, Fort Myers and the Caloosahatchee, Naples, the Everglades coast, Florida Bay, and the Keys from Islamorada to Key West and the Dry Tortugas.

areas.name: Region 11: Florida Big Bend to Mississippi Sound
areas.description: The Gulf coast from Tarpon Springs and the Big Bend to Apalachicola, Panama City, Destin, Pensacola, Mobile Bay and Mississippi Sound to Biloxi.

areas.name: Region 15: Lake Erie
areas.description: Lake Erie's US shore from Toledo and the Bass Islands to Sandusky, Cleveland, Erie and Dunkirk, the Detroit River and Lake St. Clair. Great Lakes depths are charted to Low Water Datum, not MLLW.
